title:
Size-constrained
agglomerative clustering
subtitle: CLUSTERING FOR EDA / LAB 4
points: Capacity decides which merges are legal.

cues.en: How can we group connected cells without making any cluster too large?
cues.zh: 如何把连接紧密的电路单元分组，同时避免任何簇过大？

cues.en: This lesson explains size-constrained agglomerative clustering through one small graph.
cues.zh: 本课通过一个小图，讲解带大小约束的凝聚式聚类。

cues.en: We will follow merges, measure cutsize, and explain why the algorithm can stop early.
cues.zh: 我们将跟踪合并过程、计算割边权重总和，并解释算法为何有时提前停止。

cues.en: By the end, you should be able to reproduce the result and report its limitations.
cues.zh: 学完后，你应能复现结果，并说明它的局限。

cues.en: In this simplified E D A model, each node represents a cell.
cues.zh: 在这个简化的电子设计自动化模型中，每个节点代表一个电路单元。

cues.en: An edge weight describes connectivity: a larger weight means a stronger connection.
cues.zh: 边权表示连接强度：权重越大，连接越强。

cues.en: A node also has a size, which can represent cell area rather than node count.
cues.zh: 节点还有大小属性，可以代表单元面积，而不只是节点个数。

cues.en: Here every node has size one, so cluster size equals its number of members.
cues.zh: 这里每个节点的大小都是一，因此簇大小等于成员个数。

cues.en: Real netlists may use hypergraphs; this lab deliberately uses an undirected weighted graph.
cues.zh: 真实网表可能使用超图；本实验特意采用无向加权图。

title: Target K and capacity
subtitle: A GOAL AND A HARD CONSTRAINT
points: target K = desired number of clusters
capacity = maximum total size per cluster
A legal merge must satisfy size(X) + size(Y) ≤ capacity
K is a target, not a guarantee

cues.en: Target K is the desired number of clusters at the end.
cues.zh: 目标 K 表示最终期望得到的簇数。

cues.en: Capacity is a hard upper limit on the total size inside each cluster.
cues.zh: 容量是每个簇内总大小不可超过的上限。

cues.en: With capacity two, two unit-size cells fit together, but a third cell does not.
cues.zh: 容量为二时，两个大小为一的单元可以合并，但不能再加入第三个。

cues.en: A small cutsize does not make an oversized cluster legal.
cues.zh: 割边权重总和较小，并不能让超容量的簇变得合法。

cues.en: We must report whether the algorithm actually reaches K while respecting capacity.
cues.zh: 我们必须报告算法在遵守容量约束的同时，是否真的达到目标 K。

title: Affinity and cutsize
subtitle: TWO DIFFERENT SUMS
points: affinity(X, Y): sum of edges between X and Y
cutsize: sum of all cross-cluster edge weights
A merge with affinity w reduces cutsize by w

cues.en: Affinity measures how strongly two current clusters are connected.
cues.zh: 亲和度衡量当前两个簇之间的连接强度。

cues.en: Add every original edge weight that connects one cluster to the other.
cues.zh: 将连接这两个簇的所有原始边权相加。

cues.en: Cutsize adds all edges whose endpoints belong to different clusters, counting each edge once.
cues.zh: 割边权重总和统计端点位于不同簇的全部边，每条边只计一次。

cues.en: When two clusters merge, their connecting edges become internal.
cues.zh: 两个簇合并后，它们之间的边就变成簇内边。

cues.en: So cutsize falls by exactly their affinity; no other partition boundary changes.
cues.zh: 因此割边权重总和恰好减少两簇的亲和度，其他分组边界不变。

title: The deterministic greedy rule
subtitle: REPEAT UNTIL K OR NO LEGAL POSITIVE MERGE
points: 2. Rank legal positive-affinity pairs by descending affinity.
3. Break ties by sorted member labels, then merge.
4. Update sizes and affinities after contraction.
Tie key: (sorted members of X, sorted members of Y)

cues.en: Start with one cluster per node, then consider pairs with positive affinity.
cues.zh: 从每个节点各自成簇开始，只考虑亲和度为正的簇对。

cues.en: Discard pairs that would exceed capacity, and choose the strongest remaining pair.
cues.zh: 排除合并后超容量的簇对，再选择剩余候选中亲和度最高的。

cues.en: For ties, sort the members within each cluster, then order the two clusters lexicographically.
cues.zh: 出现平局时，先对每个簇的成员标签排序，再按字典序排列簇对。

cues.en: Compare the first member list, then the second; the smallest pair wins.
cues.zh: 先比较第一个成员列表，再比较第二个，字典序最小的簇对优先。

cues.en: Our slides and code share this rule; upstream instead uses synthetic cluster identifiers.
cues.zh: 本课幻灯片与两种实现统一使用这条规则；上游则使用生成的簇编号。

title: Start with five singleton clusters
subtitle: STEP 0 → STEP 1
points: AB and DE tie at affinity 5

cues.en: Initially, all five nodes are separate, so every edge crosses a cluster boundary.
cues.zh: 初始时五个节点各自成簇，因此每条边都跨越簇边界。

cues.en: The six edge weights add to eighteen, which is our initial cutsize.
cues.zh: 六条边的权重之和为十八，这就是初始割边权重总和。

cues.en: Nodes A and B, and nodes D and E, each have affinity five.
cues.zh: A 与 B、D 与 E 的亲和度都是五。

cues.en: Our tie-break first merges nodes A and B, with combined size two.
cues.zh: 按照平局规则，先合并 A 与 B，合并后的大小为二。

cues.en: Their edge becomes internal, reducing cutsize from eighteen to thirteen.
cues.zh: 它们之间的边变为簇内边，使割边权重总和从十八降到十三。

title: Contraction updates affinity
subtitle: AFTER MERGING A + B
points: The internal AB edge is no longer a candidate

cues.en: Contraction replaces A and B by one current cluster while retaining both original members.
cues.zh: 收缩操作将 A 和 B 替换为一个当前簇，同时保留两个原始成员。

cues.en: The new connection to C combines the old A to C and B to C edges.
cues.zh: 新簇与 C 的连接需要合并原来的 A 到 C、B 到 C 两条边。

cues.en: Their weights are one and four, giving affinity five.
cues.zh: 两条边的权重分别为一和四，因此亲和度为五。

cues.en: Do not keep only the largest edge, and do not reuse a stale candidate ranking.
cues.zh: 不能只保留最大的那条边，也不能继续使用过时的候选排序。

cues.en: The next choice must use these updated affinities and the updated cluster sizes.
cues.zh: 下一次选择必须使用更新后的亲和度与簇大小。

cues.en: Now set target K to two and capacity to two.
cues.zh: 现在将目标 K 设为二，容量也设为二。

cues.en: Although the A B cluster connects strongly to C, combining them would create size three.
cues.zh: 虽然 A、B 所在簇与 C 的连接很强，合并后大小却会达到三。

cues.en: That merge is illegal, so we skip it and consider the next candidate.
cues.zh: 这次合并不合法，因此跳过它，继续检查下一个候选。

cues.en: D and E can merge legally, reducing cutsize by another five to eight.
cues.zh: D 与 E 可以合法合并，割边权重总和再减少五，变为八。

cues.en: Nodes A and B form one cluster, C remains alone, and nodes D and E form another.
cues.zh: A 与 B 组成一簇，C 单独成簇，D 与 E 组成另一簇。

title: Stopping early can be unavoidable
subtitle: LEGAL RESULT / TARGET NOT REACHED
points: Five units cannot fit into two clusters of capacity two

cues.en: We now have three clusters, and none of the remaining positive-affinity merges is legal.
cues.zh: 现在有三个簇，剩余亲和度为正的合并都不合法。

cues.en: The algorithm stops even though target K is two.
cues.zh: 虽然目标 K 为二，算法仍必须停止。

cues.en: This target is fundamentally infeasible: two clusters of capacity two hold only four units.
cues.zh: 这个目标本身不可行：两个容量为二的簇最多容纳四个大小单位。

cues.en: Our graph contains five units, so no algorithm can satisfy both requirements.
cues.zh: 图中共有五个大小单位，因此任何算法都无法同时满足这两个要求。

cues.en: The result respects capacity, but target reached must be reported as false.
cues.zh: 结果符合容量约束，但“是否达到目标”必须报告为否。

title: Capacity 3 allows ABC
subtitle: K = 2 / CAPACITY = 3
points: AB + C → ABC, affinity 5 (tie-break before DE)
ABC and DE: sizes 3 and 2; cutsize 3

cues.en: Restart from singletons, keeping target K at two but increasing capacity to three.
cues.zh: 重新从单节点簇开始，保持目标 K 为二，把容量提高到三。

cues.en: After merging nodes A and B, their cluster can now legally absorb node C.
cues.zh: 合并 A 与 B 后，它们所在的簇现在可以合法吸收 C。

cues.en: This ties with D and E, but our rule first merges the A B cluster with C.
cues.zh: 它的亲和度与 D、E 簇对相同，成员标签规则优先选择前者。

cues.en: Then D and E merge, leaving two clusters: A with B and C, and D with E.
cues.zh: 随后合并 D 与 E，最终得到 A、B、C 一簇和 D、E 一簇。

cues.en: Only the C to D and C to E edges cross, so cutsize is three.
cues.zh: 只有 C 到 D、C 到 E 两条边跨簇，因此割边权重总和为三。

title: Four settings, two partitions
subtitle: THE REQUIRED COMPARISON
points: Capacity 2 keeps C separate from AB
With K = 3, the same three-cluster partition reaches the target

cues.en: Without a capacity limit, target K of two produces the same partition and cutsize three.
cues.zh: 没有容量限制时，目标 K 为二仍得到相同分组，割边权重总和为三。

cues.en: With capacity two, the result has three clusters and cutsize eight.
cues.zh: 容量为二时，结果有三个簇，割边权重总和为八。

cues.en: The difference of five comes exactly from A to C and B to C becoming cross-cluster edges.
cues.zh: 多出的五，恰好来自 A 到 C 和 B 到 C 两条边变成跨簇边。

cues.en: If target K is three instead, that same capacity-two result successfully reaches the target.
cues.zh: 如果目标 K 改为三，那么同一个容量为二的结果就成功达到目标。

title: A reproducible implementation
subtitle: THE SAME RULE IN PYTHON AND THE BROWSER
points: Recompute affinity from original edges and current membership.
Stop only after checking all candidates.
Report count, cutsize, sizes, capacity compliance and target reached.

cues.en: For a small teaching graph, recomputing affinities from original edges is a clear implementation.
cues.zh: 对于教学小图，从原始边重新计算亲和度是一种清晰的实现方式。

cues.en: After each merge, update membership and sizes, then rebuild the candidate list.
cues.zh: 每次合并后，更新成员关系和大小，再重建候选列表。

cues.en: One blocked candidate does not justify stopping; another legal pair may still exist.
cues.zh: 一个候选被容量阻止，并不意味着可以停止；可能还有其他合法簇对。

cues.en: Stop at K, or when every positive-affinity candidate is illegal.
cues.zh: 达到 K 时停止，或者在所有正亲和度候选都不合法时停止。

cues.en: Our reference rejects invalid sizes and never forces a zero-affinity merge just to reach K.
cues.zh: 参考实现拒绝无效大小，也不会为了凑够 K 而强行合并零亲和度簇对。

title: A feasible target can defeat greedy
subtitle: COUNTEREXAMPLE / CAPACITY = 3 / K = 2

cues.en: Now consider a different graph with sizes two, two, one, and one.
cues.zh: 现在看另一个图，四个节点大小分别为二、二、一、一。

cues.en: The strongest edge joins C and D, so greedy merges them first.
cues.zh: 最强的边连接 C 与 D，因此贪心算法先合并它们。

cues.en: All three remaining clusters have size two, and capacity three blocks every further merge.
cues.zh: 剩下的三个簇大小都为二，容量三使后续任何合并都不合法。

cues.en: Yet pairing node A with C, and node B with D, gives two legal clusters of size three.
cues.zh: 但 A 与 C、B 与 D 分别成簇，就能得到两个大小为三的合法簇。

cues.en: Here the target is feasible; the greedy history, not total available capacity, causes the failure.
cues.zh: 这里目标是可行的；失败源于贪心选择的历史，而不是总容量不足。

title: A legal result may be suboptimal
subtitle: COUNTEREXAMPLE / UNIT SIZES / CAPACITY = 2 / K = 2
points: Choosing the best immediate merge does not guarantee the best partition

cues.en: In this four-node example, every size is one and capacity is two.
cues.zh: 在这个四节点例子中，每个节点大小为一，容量为二。

cues.en: Greedy takes the weight-ten A B edge, then the weight-one C D edge.
cues.zh: 贪心先选择权重十的 A、B 边，再选择权重一的 C、D 边。

cues.en: The result reaches K legally, but its cross-cluster edges sum to eighteen.
cues.zh: 结果合法达到 K，但跨簇边的权重总和为十八。

cues.en: Pairing node A with C, and node B with D, instead gives cutsize eleven.
cues.zh: 如果改为 A 与 C、B 与 D 分别成簇，割边权重总和只有十一。

cues.en: This better legal partition proves that greedy does not guarantee global optimality.
cues.zh: 这个更好的合法分组说明：贪心算法不保证全局最优。

title: Your experiment and implementation
subtitle: PREDICT → RUN → EXPLAIN
points: Run all four settings on the original graph.
Predict the next legal merge before stepping.
Submit the trace and a complete metric report.

cues.en: In the interactive lab, predict the next merge before revealing it.
cues.zh: 在交互实验中，先预测下一次合并，再查看结果。

cues.en: Run all four parameter settings and explain each stopping condition.
cues.zh: 运行四组参数，并解释每组为什么停止。

cues.en: Then complete the Python exercise and compare it with the reference traces.
cues.zh: 随后完成 Python 实现练习，并与参考轨迹比较。

cues.en: Report actual cluster count, cutsize, sizes, capacity compliance, and whether K was reached.
cues.zh: 记录实际簇数、割边权重总和、各簇大小、容量是否合规，以及是否达到 K。

cues.en: Passing a quiz checks understanding, but does not replace implementation or maintenance.
cues.zh: 测验通过可以检验理解，但本身不能替代实现任务或课程维护交付。

title: What a correct result tells us
subtitle: LAB 4 / RECAP
points: Capacity compliance and reaching K are separate outcomes.
Greedy is reproducible, not globally optimal.

cues.en: Affinity guides the choice, while capacity determines which choices are legal.
cues.zh: 亲和度指导选择，容量决定哪些选择合法。

cues.en: Contraction changes the graph, so every later decision must use updated information.
cues.zh: 收缩会改变图，因此后续决策必须使用更新后的信息。

cues.en: A legal partition, reaching the target, and global optimality are three different outcomes.
cues.zh: 始终区分分组合法、达到目标和全局最优这三件事。

cues.en: The five-node example comes from Yongfu Li's E D A learning course.
cues.zh: 本课的五节点例子来自 Yongfu Li 的 EDA learning 课程。

cues.en: This lesson adds new explanations, narration, bilingual captions, and reproducible exercises.
cues.zh: 本课新增讲解、配音、双语字幕与可复现实验。
